verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud's pricing page documents compute autoscaling limits explicitly meant to stop runaway queries from producing unexpected bills. That is a product-native cap on one cost driver, but it is a single pricing-page mention rather than a dollar spend cap. Missing for 10: usage or billing alert notifications, hard dollar-denominated spend caps, controls covering storage and traffic as well as compute, in-depth configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spend caps or usage alerts so a runaway query or traffic spike cannot produce a surprise bill

citations.quote: Set compute autoscaling limits to prevent runaway queries from unexpected bills
